title: Pass text to another program via stdin
summary: Send a string of text directly into another command as input. This is commonly used to pipe data into filters, formatters, or other utilities.

steps.explain: Use the pipe operator (|) to send the output of echo directly into the standard input of another program.

placeholders.name: TEXT
placeholders.description: The text to pass as input

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: The command that will receive the text
